entities.summary: Arab, a notable figure in the history of Syria, associated with Umayyad Caliphate from Damascus (636–715). Preceded by Arab Conquest and Umayyad Capital and Battle of Yarmouk — decisive Arab victory over Byzantium opens Syria to Islam. Their legacy influenced Abbasid Revolution overthrows the Umayyads; capital moves to Baghdad and Abbasid Revolution.
